caption: The drawing depicts a wooden humanoid figure on a plain, off-white background. The figure is carved from wood and is colored in various shades of brown, suggesting the natural wood grain. It has a large head with short, dark hair, two ears, and prominent facial features including eyes, a nose, and a mouth. The eyes are outlined with a darker shade, and the lips are subtly colored. The figure’s right arm is bent at the elbow with the hand across its chest, while the left arm is raised with the palm open and fingers spread. The hands and feet are oversized in proportion to the rest of the body, with carved and painted toes and fingernails. The legs are slightly apart, and one foot is turned outward. There is a visible seam or joint in the middle of the torso and between some limbs, indicating the figure may have articulated parts. The artist’s name, “STANLEY WAZUR,” is printed in small letters near the bottom right of the image.
title: Figure
